name: canvas-room

description.en: The room/kitchen board drawn on ONE <canvas> by Rust (crates/dowiz-canvas, Wave CV row CV1) at /room/canvas/, beside the old room page. With the room's own session it reads the pass (GET /api/staff/kitchen) and the floor (GET /api/staff/room), listens on /api/live, and a tap on a ticket's bump button sends the console's own action (POST /api/owner/orders/:id/action). The page body holds exactly one element at rest; the site's CSP lets it compile the wasm.
description.uk: Дошка зали й кухні, намальована Rust на одному <canvas> за адресою /room/canvas/: ті самі дані й дії, що й у персоналу; у body рівно один елемент.

producer.what: onIntent kind 1 (bump): POST /api/owner/orders/:id/action {location_id, action}; the intent comes from crates/dowiz-canvas/src/board/mod.rs Board::tap (Act::Bump)

consumer.what: owner::order_action (lib.rs POST /api/owner/orders/:id/action), Staff(&PASS) door, the kernel FSM decides the edge

readback.what: kitchen_orders(): GET /api/staff/kitchen -- the board's own read shows the ticket in its new status

external_note: No external API. The page is static assets (index.html, loader.js, board.js, feed.js, board.wasm) served by the edge under workers/api/public/_headers; its CSP must carry script-src 'wasm-unsafe-eval'.

auth.how: the owner's token signs the room session (staff_at accepts an owner for Cap::Advance and Cap::TakeOrders), exactly as feature-offline-sale does

probe: tools/live-proof/probes/feature-canvas-room.mjs: place a TEST order; open /room/canvas/ signed in with the owner token; body has 1 element; the page's CSP and the wasm's content-type; find the TEST ticket's Accept button in the scene (bump_rect), click it with a real mouse; GET /api/staff/kitchen and the owner's order show CONFIRMED; body still 1 element; close the order.
